sm.totalCalc: Total THC/CBD = neutral form + 0.877 × acid form, calculated by the authors; missing acid forms were assumed to be 0 there. Unit: percent by weight.
sm.terpNote: Terpenes: only compounds frequently measured by all labs; ocimene and nerolidol as the sum of their isomers (Σ). According to the source, “0” means not detected or below the limit of quantification; values not measured are not included.
sm.matching: Matched by exactly identical name only (including version); autoflower strains are excluded.
